title: Switch TermAl's source_id consumers to commit ids + one diff hash, in step with Engram w-d895ea3ac77c
outcome:
Engram w-d895ea3ac77c (P0, owner Engram 11334) changes the shared source_id to root and submodule commit ids plus ONE hash of the Git diff, replacing the per-changed-file changes[] list. This follows Greg's final correction, relayed by Kimi: no per-file inventory or hash-object census, no second identity.
TermAl reads that shape in several places: the launcher (request.sourceId and results.sourceIdBefore/After validation), the host adapter and source-owner admission, and K3 remote comparisons. TermAl's strict readers switch at ONE agreed switch point with the producer, per the rollout rule in docs/features/source-identity.md. Stored records stay readable as stored and are never recomputed. No parallel identity.
Steps: TermAl reviews Engram's design note for the delta definition; this item's owner lists every TermAl reader of source_id; then the readers switch in the same window as the producer.
acceptance: Every TermAl reader and comparison of the shared source_id (launcher, host adapter, source-owner admission, K3/remote) accepts the new commit-ids-plus-diff-hash shape at the agreed switch point, with stored older records still read as stored and never recomputed.
Behaviour tests on those readers cover the new shape and an older stored record. No test pins source text, and no second identity or parallel format is introduced.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input, landed in the same window as Engram's producer change.
